recommendations.action: Instrument a canonical subscription lifecycle and monthly eligible-customer snapshot
recommendations.evidence: account flag (110), any-event label (352), non-reactivation-event label (339), and subscription-flag accounts (312) disagree; 4,514 subscription rows have no end_date while 486 are flagged ended
recommendations.benefit: enables valid churn denominators, lifecycle reconciliation, and future experiments
recommendations.effort: medium; estimate only after system inventory
recommendations.success_metric: reconciled account/subscription state and timestamped eligible cohort coverage
recommendations.limitation: dataset is synthetic and conflicting; cannot infer production system causes
recommendations.validation: reconcile source-of-truth events and subscription states for a prospective cohort

recommendations.action: Use reason codes and account examples as interview prompts, not root-cause verdicts
recommendations.evidence: 600 event rows include reason codes features=114, support=104, budget=104, unknown=95, competitor=92, pricing=91; reactivation rows included unless filtered
recommendations.success_metric: coded, dated interviews linked to verified lifecycle outcomes
recommendations.limitation: reason_code is self-reported/synthetic and is not causal evidence
recommendations.validation: sample cancellation interviews and compare reason consistency with subsequent lifecycle

recommendations.action: Pilot an adoption/support outreach only after a prospective eligibility rule is defined
recommendations.evidence: all-time usage per account and ticket satisfaction are descriptive and not temporally aligned; mean satisfaction 3.980 among event accounts (815 scored of 1,395 tickets) vs 3.983 among no-event accounts (360/605)
recommendations.benefit: test whether targeted outreach changes retained-customer outcomes
recommendations.effort: pilot staffing and cost unknown; budget should be set by owner
recommendations.success_metric: pre-registered 90-day account retention plus guardrails for support satisfaction and cost
recommendations.limitation: no causal uplift or recoverable revenue can be estimated from current data
recommendations.validation: randomize eligible accounts to outreach vs usual care, stratify by plan and baseline usage, analyze intention-to-treat

limitations: All five tables are synthetic according to the supplied dataset README.
Account churn flag, subscription churn flag, event history, and end_date do not reconcile.
No reliable eligible-customer time denominator or historical snapshot is present; event counts are not churn rates.
Event rows include reactivations and repeated account events; reason codes are not causal proof.
Usage and support comparisons are all-time/cross-sectional unless explicitly filtered; temporal sequence is not a defensible pre-churn design.
Subscription financial rows are repeated contract records; sums are not current MRR/ARR, lost revenue, or recoverable revenue.
No calibrated risk model or causal intervention effect is estimated.
